style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots, flat solid pastel colour blocks #E9DDF2 / #C77FD4 / #C3CCF7 / #F5A9A2 for benefit, spec and lifestyle shots, never textured or graded
style.direction: pop color-block beauty commerce with identity-free eye close-ups
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight hand-drawn arrow callouts and blank label chips in deep charcoal #2D2D2D, otherwise none
style.lightingSystem: bright neutral high-key studio light with one hard directional key that throws a single crisp graphic shadow on colour blocks; soft wrap and skimming light on skin and macro detail
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent pop colour-block beauty ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, pale lilac #E9DDF2, orchid #C77FD4 and periwinkle #C3CCF7 with coral #F5A9A2 as the closing field; neutral high-key studio lighting with one hard directional key that casts a single crisp graphic shadow; bold geometric sans-serif display type only; thin single-weight arrow callouts and blank label chips in deep charcoal #2D2D2D; flat solid colour-block backgrounds with no texture and no gradient; stable slight 3/4 tube angle and scale with tube and wand presented as one set; people cropped to the eye region or nose-down so no identity is readable; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no gradient backdrops, no identifiable faces.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 tube angle and scale, tube and its wand always read as one set, tube never cropped; every human presence is limited to an eye-region crop from brow to upper cheek or a nose-to-collarbone crop so no identity is legible
style.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper colour blocks laid flat, no props, no surface texture
style.typography: bold geometric sans-serif display headlines only, oversized on flat colour, one family, no script or serif
